title: Seating plan
loadFailed: Could not load the plan. Try again.
saveFailed: Could not save. Check the values and try again.
conflictHelp: Writes are paused. Reload the current plan before continuing; your change did not silently overwrite someone else's.
reloadRequired: The save outcome is unconfirmed. Reload before continuing.
geometry: The entire rotated table must stay inside the room. The change was reverted; adjust size or position.
name: Name
templateHelp: A template copies its own room dimensions and tables. Entered dimensions apply to a blank plan.
sourceHelp: Statuses come from this invitation only. Changing it does not change participants or assignments.
selectTable: Select a table on the canvas or in the list.
capacityHelp: Resizing does not change seats. Seats cannot be reduced below the number of assigned guests.
centerHelp: Position is the table center; rotation is around its center.
newPersonHelp: Choose a person from this project or add a new one without an invitation. The person will be included in this plan.
notLinked: Not linked to the selected invitation
deleteHelp: Remove “{name}”? The project person is preserved. Deleting a table removes its assignments; removing a participant removes their assignment; deleting a plan removes its layout.
canvasHelp: Drag the background to pan · Space or Hand only move the view · Pinch to zoom
capacityError: The table is full or the new capacity is below its occupancy.
archivedError: Archived people cannot be included or assigned.
plansHelp: Open an existing layout or create a new one for this project.
createPlanHelp: Choose an empty room or an active template. Edit the name, room dimensions and RSVP source later in plan settings.
directEditHelp: Drag the table to move it. Use its handles to resize or rotate.
dragGuest: Drag {name} to a table or tap to select
placeOnCanvas: Choose a table on the canvas
guestDragHelp: Drag the grip beside a guest onto a table, or tap it and choose a table. The menu is also available beside their name.
personCreatedNotIncluded: The person was created. Inclusion in the plan is unconfirmed. After resolving the error, include the same person; they will not be created again.
dropMiss: Guest was not assigned. Drop onto a table or select one from the menu.
